API ReferenceZIdentity APIGroupsGroups Ops List
Groups Ops List
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/groups

Retrieves a paginated list of groups with optional query parameters for pagination and filtering by group name or dynamic group status.

To learn more, see About User Groups.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
offset
int32

Possible values: >= 0

The starting point for pagination, with the number of records that can be skipped before fetching results.

limit
int32

Possible values: >= 0 and <= 1000

The maximum number of records to return per request. Minimum: 0, Maximum: 1000

name[like]
string

Filters results by group name using a case-insensitive partial match.

excludedynamicgroups
boolean

Excludes dynamic groups from the results.

Responses
​
200
401

The request was successful, and a paginated list of groups are returned.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
results_total
int64
REQUIRED

The total number of groups available.

pageOffset
int64
REQUIRED

The starting point of the current page in pagination. Helps determine which set of records is being displayed.

pageSize
int64
REQUIRED

The number of records included in a single response page.

next_link
string
REQUIRED

URL link to the next page of group records, if available. Helps to navigate through paginated results.

prev_link
string
REQUIRED

URL link to the previous page of group records, if available.

records
object[]
REQUIRED
]
